pre_data_amendments.data_state: Only HTTP headers for one official spot archive and one official perpetual archive were read to estimate storage. No archive payload, checksum payload, aggregate-trade row, feature, signal, virtual trade or performance result was read.
pre_data_amendments.change: Clarified the matched control from 'no-signal' to 'another eligible grid point on the same UTC day'.
pre_data_amendments.reason: The stated purpose is an unconditional same-time random-hold baseline. Calling it a no-signal control would make a stronger and unsupported conditioning claim.
pre_data_amendments.unchanged: All dates, signal thresholds, entry delay, hold, costs, bootstrap seed, gates, OOS lock and simulation-only restriction remain unchanged.

hypothesis: When BTCUSDT USD-M perpetual aggressive buy imbalance over the last completed ten minutes is at least +0.25 while BTCUSDT spot aggressive buy imbalance is at most -0.10, a delayed spot-only four-hour long hold has positive incremental net expectancy after fixed spot fees and slippage.

independence.from_alpha011: Both candidates use order-flow data, but Alpha 011 uses one perpetual market at fixed quarter-hour openings and a twelve-hour futures position. Alpha 016 tests a cross-market disagreement, uses a completed ten-minute window, and evaluates a spot-only virtual long. PnL correlation and shared-data dependence remain unmeasured; it is not eligible as an independent portfolio sleeve.
independence.from_alpha012: Alpha 012 is a delta-neutral spot/perpetual carry hypothesis with funding. Alpha 016 has intentional outright spot direction and never credits funding.

research_scope.purpose: historical simulation may reject the hypothesis only; a pass would require a separately preregistered forward study before any promotion discussion.

data.spot_source: Binance official public-data daily spot aggTrades archives and publisher SHA-256 checksum files
data.perpetual_source: Binance official public-data daily USD-M futures aggTrades archives and publisher SHA-256 checksum files
data_admission: Verify archive checksum, filename, CSV schema, symbol, UTC-day containment and non-empty rows before use.
Require unique, monotonically increasing and consecutive aggregate-trade IDs within and across every consumed UTC day for each market independently.
Reject a decision if either market lacks the complete [decision minus ten minutes, decision) observation interval, the spot entry after availability delay, or the spot exit after the fixed hold.
Do not open any locked OOS archive before every development gate is recorded as PASS.

fixed_signal.observation_window: [decision minus 10 minutes, decision), using exchange timestamps only
fixed_signal.aggressive_flow_imbalance: sum(quantity * direction) / sum(quantity), where direction is +1 when isBuyerMaker is false and -1 when true
fixed_signal.entry: first BTCUSDT spot aggregate trade at or after decision plus one minute
fixed_signal.holding_period: four hours from actual entry timestamp
fixed_signal.exit: first BTCUSDT spot aggregate trade at or after actual entry plus four hours

base.round_trip_cost_interpretation: fee is charged on executed entry and exit notional; directional adverse slippage is applied to both fills.

cost_model.funding: zero by construction: no perpetual position is modeled

control_and_statistics.control: For every signal, draw one distinct four-hour BTC spot hold from another eligible four-hour UTC grid point on the same UTC day, without replacement, using deterministic seed 16. The control is descriptive and is not a tradable portfolio; it is a random-hold baseline, not a no-signal strategy.
control_and_statistics.bootstrap: paired daily signal-minus-control net returns; seven-day moving-block bootstrap, 5,000 paths, deterministic seed 16; the 95% confidence interval lower bound must exceed zero.
control_and_statistics.lookahead_test: Change every row strictly after each decision boundary and require the feature, signal decision and entry selection to remain unchanged.
control_and_statistics.cost_repricing: Stress results may change only fixed execution costs; observations, signal timestamps, entries and exits remain sealed.

prohibited: changing any threshold, observation window, decision time, entry delay, holding period, direction, cost, random-control seed, bootstrap policy or gate after development data are read
opening the locked OOS archives if any development gate fails
treating a historical OOS pass as live-trading authorization
crediting perpetual funding, leverage, maker rebates, borrowing yield or unmodeled execution improvements
